verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official npm-distributed HubSpot CLI (`@hubspot/cli`, `hs init`) for scaffolding and building on the developer platform. It also shows versioned REST endpoints with per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs, from which clients could be generated. No official language client SDK library is documented in the pack, so support for this story is adjacent rather than direct. Missing for 10: any documented official language SDKs (e.g. Node/Python/Java client libraries), SDK reference docs or install instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
